offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures upright and conventional MRI scanners sold to hospitals and imaging centers, and manages diagnostic imaging centers that provide MRI scans to patients. Revenue comes from equipment sales, service contracts and management of affiliated imaging centers.

primary_services.value: MRI service contracts; diagnostic imaging services; imaging center management

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, imaging centers, physician groups buying scanners and service contracts; B2C: patients receiving MRI scans at managed imaging centers

revenue_model.value: product sales: MRI scanner systems sold to hospitals and imaging centers; service fees: maintenance and service contracts on installed MRI systems; commissions or management fees: management fees from affiliated diagnostic imaging centers; healthcare reimbursement: insurance and patient payments for MRI scans at imaging centers
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees; healthcare reimbursement

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds MRI scanners, sold to hospitals and imaging centers; service provider: services installed MRI systems under service contracts for healthcare providers; asset operator: owns and operates MRI equipment in managed diagnostic imaging centers, billing for scans
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: imaging centers in New York, New Jersey, Florida and other states, scanners sold across the US and abroad

specialization.value: related lines: MRI scanner manufacturing and diagnostic imaging center management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: scanners sold directly to hospitals and imaging centers; own locations: diagnostic imaging centers operated under management arrangements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: MRI devices need FDA clearance, imaging centers face state licensing and Medicare reimbursement rules

notes: Current number of managed imaging centers and the exact geographic mix of sales may have changed.
